Kamlesh Kumar @ Kamlesh Yadav .... .... .... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand .... ....
....Opposite Party

------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashok Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, Addl.P.P ------
Order No.04 Dated- 23.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Tandwa P.S. Case No. 218 of 2022 instituted under Sections 420, 468, 471, 414, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(ii) of Coal Mines Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per FIR, petitioner is owner-cum-driver of vehicle bearing Reg. No.JH-19C-5963 which was found indulged in illegal transportation of 25 tons coal without valid documents.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that nothing has been recovered from the possession of petitioner and he has no concern with seized coal.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in this case with ulterior motive.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that the involvement of petitioner was found in illegal transportation of coal without any valid papers and notices under Section 41(A) of Cr.P. C have been issued to petitioner on 16.09.2022 and 20.09.2022 with direction to keep his plea before the Investigating Officer by appearing on 19.09.2022 and 25.09.2022 respectively but he did not comply the notices.

On direction of the Hon'ble Court, the Investigating Officer again issued notices on 15.01.2023 and 01.02.2023 with direction to put his plea before the Investigating Officer by appearing on 20.01.2023 and 05.02.2023 respectively but again he did not comply the notices.
In view of above conduct of petitioner, he may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 1 Considering the facts and circumstances as stated above, coupled with materials available on record against the petitioner and seeing the conduct of petitioner in non-cooperation with investigation of the case, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly,
the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
